subdomains.name: Heroism Subdomain (Glory)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Divine Presence with Aura of Heroism and replace the Glory domain's 3rd- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Touch of Glory
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a creature to grant a bonus equal to cleric level on one Charisma-based skill or ability check within 1 hour. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Aura of Heroism
powers.summary: As a swift action, emit a 30-foot aura whose allies gain the effects of heroism for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Rounds need not be consecutive.

subdomains.name: Honor Subdomain (Glory)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Glory with Honor Bound and replace the Glory domain's 2nd- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Honor Bound
powers.summary: Touch a creature to grant one new save against each charm or compulsion currently affecting it, or use an immediate action after failing such a save yourself. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Divine Presence
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Allies within it gain sanctuary until they leave the aura or attack.

subdomains.name: Memory Subdomain (Knowledge)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Lore Keeper with Recall and replace the Knowledge domain's 2nd-, 6th-, and 8th-level spells.

powers.name: Recall
powers.summary: Touch a creature to let it retry a Knowledge check made within the past minute with an insight bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Remote Viewing
powers.summary: Use clairvoyance/clairaudience at will as a spell-like ability for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level.

subdomains.name: Thought Subdomain (Knowledge)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Remote Viewing with Read Minds and replace the Knowledge domain's 3rd-, 5th-, and 8th-level spells.

powers.name: Lore Keeper
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, gain information about a creature as though making the appropriate Knowledge check with a result equal to 15 + cleric level + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Read Minds
powers.summary: Read the surface thoughts of creatures within 30 feet after 1 round of concentration; a Will save negates. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level, which need not be consecutive.
